First Impressions SD-CSQ-4x4 4" Square Glass Door Handles

4" square glass door handles impeccably crafted from high grade 1/2" thick non rusting aluminum,finished in polished chrome.

These modern design door handles are perfect for your glass shower doors.

Specifications: of First Impressions SD-CSQ-8x8 Glass Door Handles

  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Thickness: 1/2"
  • Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Material: Solid Aluminum

Note: This beautiful door pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Sizes. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with 2 square door handles and includes all the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pull Handles)
